clinicalBenefit.value: In randomized Phase 3 MAPLE-HCM, aficamten increased peak oxygen uptake versus metoprolol at Week 24 by a least-squares mean between-group difference of +2.30 mL/kg/min (95% CI +1.52 to +3.07; p<0.0001). This verifies the trial's exercise-capacity endpoint result, not approval probability or superiority to all possible therapies.
clinicalBenefit.method: Exact NCT05767346 registry results (primary pVO2 Week 24, prespecified randomized aficamten vs metoprolol arms, least-squares difference and 95% CI), independently cross-checked against peer-reviewed NEJM MAPLE-HCM trial 10.1056/NEJMoa2504654 / PubMed PMID 40888697. Restricted to the reported endpoint; not FDA approval, all-comparator superiority, or RAAS prediction.
